upstream.uses: Per-acquisition FastaLake (public-sequence reservoir) and specimen-matched MG peptide counts at 5-50 residues, q <= 0.01, for the 282 matched CapScan acquisitions (FL_peptides, MG_peptides; panels a and b and the line-129 yields). a08_benchmark282_old.tsv is the collector's recount of the production arm and is used as a cross-check; a08_benchmark282_new.tsv is the 347-roster rerun, used as a roster check.

MG database size per specimen (sanitizer n_kept, CAPSCAN_sanitize_report.tsv), and the 282-row join of peptide counts, BioSample, region, participant and recorded DNA quantity (capscan_assembly_dna_yield_gain_by_acquisition.tsv; join code not saved). build_figures_v15.py aggregated the join into the three capsule_assembly_gain_*.tsv tables; that aggregation is ported in panels.py:derive_tables. Used by both panels and every number in NUMBERS.tsv.

9-50-residue FastaLake and MG peptide counts per matched acquisition (a08_benchmark282_old.tsv n_fl_9, n_mg_9), combined into capscan_acquisitions_9_50.tsv (panels a, b; v30 text line 129). To be replaced by the 295-acquisition CapScan MG benchmark (lab final/mg295).
